elements.text: Where aimux goes: from "watch and spawn my agents" to "run agents safely from any client". Most concepts exist; four are new

elements.title: Sessions
elements.desc:
history, catalog, sessionstate, search:
every surface already reads these

elements.title: acprun
elements.desc:
continue a session over ACP; the remote
API broker and Wingman's Page lane both use it

elements.title: Environments + runtimes
elements.desc:
local, container, k8s, OpenShell;
CreateSandbox, PolicyEnforcer interfaces

elements.title: remote API v1
elements.desc:
contract, fixtures, tailnet auth, pairing,
events, approvals, queue

elements.title: controller
elements.desc: UI-agnostic logic for TUI and web

elements.title: Profile
elements.desc:
today: saved flags (provider, dir, model, mode)
after: security contract, narrow-only, digest

elements.desc:
today: --environment openshell exists
after: --profile picks sandbox, tools, policy

elements.desc:
today: allowlist by name, readonly listener
after: any tool kind, review, pins, MCP rules

elements.desc:

also served on a local Unix socket

elements.desc:

Wingman); after: one compiler + launcher
